note: Background Explore agent: a human prompt, then a peer hand-back (origin.kind peer, isMeta true) and a task-notification (origin.kind task-notification), each of which fires UserPromptSubmit. Hook prompts observed in the conversation view: the peer turn's hook prompt is the inner <agent-message ...>...</agent-message> block of the record's content (the record wraps it in harness text before and after); the task-notification's hook prompt equals the record's content. The hook payloads themselves were not captured.
